technique_name: Describe the development of the film industry since 1975.
description: Since 1975, the film industry has undergone a significant transformation. The number of films released annually has grown exponentially, as technological advances make it easier for films to be produced and distributed. Innovations such as digital distribution, streaming technology, and 3D projection have opened up new avenues for the film industry, allowing for unprecedented access and reach.
